title: v1.1.00 — Focus Timer Without Limit, Timezone-Safe Streaks & UI Polish
description: AcademicPulse v1.1.00 introduces open-ended study in Focus Mode with live hour tracking and 1-click recording, timezone-safe streak calculations for IST, mobile touch optimizations, and analytics-exclusive AI guidance.
features:
♾️ Focus Timer Without Limit (Open Study Mode)
Study without duration ceilings! The new open-ended count-up timer in Focus Mode lets you study for any number of hours, formatted dynamically in HH:MM:SS with real-time accumulated hours tracking.

🏁 1-Click Finish & Record Action
Added a prominent 'Finish & Record' button that immediately pauses your open timer session and pre-fills your exact hours and minutes into your permanent study logs.

🛡️ Anti-Loss Timer Protection
Stopping or resetting an open study session now preserves your accumulated study time and automatically prompts you to log it, preventing any accidental loss of study hours.

🔥 Timezone-Safe Streak Tracking (IST / UTC+)
Study streaks and attendance streaks now calculate using local calendar dates rather than UTC midnight, completely eliminating off-by-one streak breaks for users in UTC+ time zones.

⚡ Mobile & UI Optimization
Enhanced touch manipulation across mobile screens, restored smooth scrolling on heatmaps and tables, integrated safe-area insets for notched phones, and improved light theme text contrast.

🤖 Standard & Topic AI Guidance in Analytics
Integrated syllabus-standard and topic-wise AI study guidance exclusively in the Analytics view, accompanied by course hub isolation and clean chart destruction lifecycles.
